# Open Compute

> Developer documentation for open-compute: a serverless platform that runs the declared Cloudflare Workers programming model on a single node (`ocd` + pinned `workerd`). No global edge, billing, or Cloudflare dashboard.

Origin: https://open-compute.dev/docs/

Each product below is a top-level docs URL. Live limits come from `ocd capabilities --json` on the running binary.

## Start

- [Overview](https://open-compute.dev/docs/): Single-node Workers platform
- [Get started](https://open-compute.dev/docs/get-started/): Hello Worker on a ready ocd
- [Directory](https://open-compute.dev/docs/directory/): Product catalog
